details: Jones is an American computer scientist and inventor working as a computer vision researcher at Mitsubishi Electric Research Laboratories.

explainer.lead: Michael J. Jones is an American computer scientist and inventor who works as a computer vision researcher at Mitsubishi Electric Research Laboratories. His research sits in the computer vision field, where visual recognition systems are built.

tiers.eli5: He is a scientist who teaches computers to understand pictures, and he does that work at a research lab.
tiers.practitioner: Computer vision engineers encounter his work through the research literature on visual recognition produced at Mitsubishi Electric Research Laboratories. A common pitfall is treating a researcher's name as a method name; attribute work correctly and check the specific publication.
tiers.paperLevel: Formally, he is identified as an American computer scientist and inventor and as a computer vision researcher at Mitsubishi Electric Research Laboratories; no specific algorithm or formula is attributed to him here.

explainer.example: A vision team searching the literature on visual recognition may come across work by Jones and his colleagues at Mitsubishi Electric Research Laboratories as background reading.
